verified_facts.text: The hotel is perched on the bank of the Qiantang River, overlooking the tidal bore.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Azure Qiantang, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Hangzhou is perched on the bank of the Qiantang River, overlooking tidal bore.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near Six Harmonies Pagoda, West Lake and Eight Diagrams Field.
verified_facts.excerpt: is near Six Harmonies Pagoda, the West Lake, Eight Diagrams Field and more.

verified_facts.text: The hotel provides access to the heart of Hangzhou.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel provides unfettered access to the vibrant heart of Hangzhou

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor pool, a spa and a fitness center.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel presents an indoor pool, a tranquil spa and a fitness center

verified_facts.text: The fitness area includes a sauna, steam room and whirlpool alongside the indoor swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: 24-hour Fitness center indoor swimming pool sauna/ steam room / Whirlpool

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have large floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Qiantang River.
verified_facts.excerpt: which includes venerable views of the Qiantang River through large floor-to-ceiling windows

verified_facts.text: Many rooms offer sweeping views of the Qiantang River; others overlook the hotel gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Many of our rooms offer sweeping views of the Qiantang River; others overlook the hotel gardens

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms are expansive and marble, stocked with luxury toiletries and with tubs with spray jets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expansive marble bathrooms are stocked with luxury toiletries and feature tubs with spray jets

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite offers extra space and Qiantang River views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reserve our gorgeously appointed Presidential Suite to enjoy extra space and Qiantang River views

verified_facts.text: Room types include a Panoramic Suite with 270-degree views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Panoramic Suite with 270°

verified_facts.text: Panorama Restaurant has a front-row view of the Qiantang River and an outdoor terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Panorama Restaurant commands a front-row view of the Qiantang River, featuring 145 dining seats and an outdoor terrace.

verified_facts.text: Lan Ting, on the hotel's 23rd and 24th floors, serves regional Chinese cuisine and has a tea bar with river views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor regional Chinese cuisine and enjoy our tea bar as you gaze at the river from the main dining room and from 10 private dining rooms.

verified_facts.text: Lan Ting is on the hotel's 23rd and 24th floors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched on the hotel's 23rd and 24th floors, Lan Ting offers an authentic dining experience for lunch and dinner.

verified_facts.text: BO Lobby Lounge & Bar offers themed afternoon tea, desserts and specialty drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: It offers themed afternoon tea, desserts, and specialty drinks.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a grand ballroom and seven meeting rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: A majestic grand ballroom and seven spacious meeting rooms ensure indelible events.

verified_facts.text: Room service is available 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: 24 Hour Room Service

verified_facts.text: Self parking is complimentary for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Self parking is complimentary for guests.

verified_facts.text: Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport is about 25 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: HGH is located approximately 25.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The Azure Qiantang, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Hangzhou.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is served at Panorama All-day Dining Restaurant for a fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at Panorama All-day Dining Restaurant for a fee.
